DML.SELECT: SELECT alarm_config_id as "alarmConfigId", source_element_type_id as "sourceElementTypeId", source_element_id as "sourceElementId", target_element_type_id as "targetElementTypeId", target_element_id as "targetElementId" FROM conf.alarm_target_elements
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.alarm_target_elements (alarm_config_id, source_element_type_id, source_element_id, target_element_type_id, target_element_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:alarmConfigId, :sourceElementTypeId, :sourceElementId, :targetElementTypeId, :targetElementId, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.alarm_target_elements WHERE alarm_config_id = :alarmConfigId AND source_element_type_id = :sourceElementTypeId AND source_element_id = :sourceElementId AND target_element_type_id = :targetElementTypeId AND target_element_id = :targetElementId
